note: The hash-registered Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0 BCL assemblies that are the behaviour authority for the selected BCL families this binding derives its support classes from. This registry is deliberately SEPARATE from tools/api_compat/registered-assemblies.json: that one is calibrated by reproducing the pinned 257-type/2964-member XNA contract, and a BCL assembly declares zero XNA contract types, so that gate would pass vacuously. Authority here is earned instead by reproducing a pinned selected-shape manifest, by independently-stated sentinel facts, by mutation self-tests, and by an independent metadata reader. Only digests and identity are retained; no Microsoft binary is stored in the repository.

versionResource.FileDescription: Microsoft Common Language Runtime Class Library

selectedFamilies.reason: The direct CLR base of Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GameComponentCollection. Its public surface, its protected Items view and its four protected virtual hooks are the behaviour CNACollection<Element> projects.

The direct CLR base of ModelBoneCollection, ModelMeshCollection, ModelMeshPartCollection and ModelEffectCollection, and the declared return type of several still-deferred XNA members. Projected as CNAReadOnlyCollection<Element>.

Collection<T>..ctor() allocates exactly this type as its backing store, so its observable list behaviour -- bounds rules, version bumps and element ordering -- is part of Collection<T>'s own behaviour. Projected as CNAList<Element>.
Collection<T>.GetEnumerator() returns the backing list's enumerator, so this is where the mutation-invalidation contract CNAEnumerator projects is actually declared.
The declared type of Collection<T>.items and ReadOnlyCollection<T>.list, of both wrapping constructors and of the protected Items property. Every one of the four hooks is a call on this interface.
Supplies the Count and IsReadOnly reads that guard every Collection<T> mutator, and the Clear/Contains/CopyTo the hooks and public methods delegate to.
Supplies the GetEnumerator that Collection<T>.GetEnumerator and ReadOnlyCollection<T>.GetEnumerator delegate to.
The declared return type of GetEnumerator on both selected collection families; it is the CLR contract CNAEnumerator<Element> projects.

The direct CLR base of NoMicrophoneConnectedException, ContentLoadException, DeviceLostException, DeviceNotResetException and NoSuitableGraphicsDeviceException, the transitive base of the other three XNA exception types, and the declared parameter type of every two-argument XNA exception constructor and of Game.ShowMissingRequirementMessage. It owns the whole observable state those eight types have -- Message, InnerException, HResult -- because every one of their constructors is a bare forward to it. Projected as CNAException.

The exact direct CLR base of ExternalException. It is not a marker: each of its constructors substitutes the resource message Arg_SystemException and sets HResult to 0x80131501, which ExternalException then overwrites, so collapsing it would change both. Projected as CNASystemException.

The direct CLR base of Microsoft.Xna.Framework.LaunchParameters, which declares one parameterless constructor and inherits everything else. Its bucket/entry/free-list storage is what defines the enumeration order, the duplicate-key refusal and the version invalidation CNADictionary<Key, Value> projects.
The declared type of Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.Keys. A live view over the dictionary, not a copy, projected as the nested CNADictionary.KeyCollection.
The declared type of Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.Values, projected as the nested CNADictionary.ValueCollection.

The declared return type of Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.GetEnumerator. Its whole surface is Current/MoveNext/Dispose, so it is the IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey,TValue>> contract CNAEnumerator already projects, and admitting it is what proves the struct adds nothing that projection would drop.
The element type of Dictionary<TKey,TValue> enumeration. A CLR struct with two get-only properties, projected as the Swift struct CNAKeyValuePair<Key, Value>.

The declared type of Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.Comparer and of three of its constructors. It is what the dictionary asks for BOTH halves of key identity, so a caller-supplied comparer decides which keys collide and which are equal. Projected as the CNAEqualityComparer protocol.

The declared parameter type of two Dictionary<TKey,TValue> constructors and the interface whose members the class implements as sealed virtual finals; it is what establishes that nothing on the public surface is an override point.

The direct CLR base of InstancePlayLimitException, NoAudioHardwareException and StorageDeviceNotConnectedException. It substitutes the resource message Arg_ExternalException, sets HResult to 0x80004005, and adds the public ErrorCode property that reads it. Projected as CNAExternalException.

selectedResourceStrings.reason: System.Exception.get_Message returns this, formatted with GetClassName(), whenever the stored message is null -- which every parameterless XNA exception constructor produces. Read from the assembly's own embedded mscorlib.resources, never from documentation or memory.
The message System.SystemException..ctor() passes to its base.

selectedResourceStrings.value: External component has thrown an exception.
selectedResourceStrings.reason: The message System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExternalException..ctor() passes to its base, and therefore the Message of a parameterless InstancePlayLimitException, NoAudioHardwareException or StorageDeviceNotConnectedException.

selectedResourceStrings.value: An item with the same key has already been added.
selectedResourceStrings.reason: ExceptionResource 14, which Dictionary<TKey,TValue>::Insert passes to ThrowHelper::ThrowArgumentException when Add is given a key that is already present.

selectedResourceStrings.value: The given key was not present in the dictionary.
selectedResourceStrings.reason: The message KeyNotFoundException..ctor() carries, which Dictionary<TKey,TValue>::get_Item raises through ThrowHelper::ThrowKeyNotFoundException.
The message a negative capacity produces on the Dictionary<TKey,TValue> capacity constructors.

selectedResourceStrings.value: Destination array is not long enough to copy all the items in the collection. Check array index and length.
selectedResourceStrings.reason: The message KeyCollection.CopyTo and ValueCollection.CopyTo raise for a destination that cannot hold the collection from the supplied index.

selectedStaticTables.reason: Dictionary<TKey,TValue>::Initialize and ::Resize size their bucket and entry arrays with HashHelpers.GetPrime, which reads this 72-entry table. Nothing observable depends on it -- enumeration order is entry order and a lookup is correct for any bucket count -- but transcribing it by hand would be a sizing decision of this projection's own, so it is read out of the assembly's static-array initializer and compared against the Swift source.

availableButNotAdmitted.reason: Present and identity-established on this machine, but no family it declares is required by any implemented projection. System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter and ExpandableObjectConverter remain an undecided public support-family question, so admitting the assembly now would register authority nothing consumes.
